summary: Vista Energy filed a Form 6-K announcing an update to its 2026-2028 guidance and 2030 vision. This is an ordinary business update, not a special situation. The update reflects the consolidation of recently acquired blocks and an assumed higher oil price scenario. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special event is disclosed. The filing is a routine operational guidance revision, equivalent to a press release for a foreign private issuer. No deal terms are stated.
